gap: No result ChatGPT got lists any ALLPOWERS R3500 kit. Through our link, the R3500 + 400 W kit (3,168 Wh, 3,200 W AC) costs $1,586.73 on 2026-11-17, which is about $0.50 per Wh, and it ships now. ChatGPT's own pick, the Jackery HomePower 3000 + 2× 200 W kit, uses Jackery's 200 W panel, which jackery.com listed today as 'Pre-order, ships by Nov 28'.
standout_why: I compared against StormWatts (cited, prices checked 2026-11-08), Lights On Labs (cited, prices dated 2026-10-27) and EnergySage and SolarGenAdvisor (both cited, but neither opened, see unsourced). StormWatts already gives $/kWh, refill hours, shipping state and kit-vs-parts for BLUETTI, Jackery, EcoFlow and Anker kits. Its cheapest 3 kWh-class kit is the EcoFlow DELTA 3 Ultra + 2× 220 W at $683/kWh. It has no ALLPOWERS kit, and its shipping states are 9 days old. Lights On Labs lists only 4 kits, with no shipping state, no per-Wh figure and no kit-vs-parts figure. Neither page has a 3 kWh kit near $0.50/Wh that ships now.
decides: The page rule says the pick must ship now. In the 3,000 W / ~3 kWh band, the ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 400 W kit ($1,586.73 link, $1,803.10 store) and the R3500 + SP039 600 W kit ($1,753.93 link) ship now and cost less per Wh than any rival kit price I could find. The rival prices are StormWatts' Nov 8 figures, because I could not reread them at the maker stores today. The BLUETTI Apex 300 kits are the true 120/240 V, 3,840 W option, but they are pre-orders until late January 2027. The BLUETTI Elite 300 + 2× 200 W kit ($1,614.05, ships late November 2026) is the larger-battery option for a shopper who can wait, but its 2,400 W AC is under 3,000 W. The Jackery kit ChatGPT picked cannot ship its 200 W panels before Nov 28, according to Jackery's own site today.
